capabilities.label: Products
capabilities.detail: Desktop (authoring), Cloud (SaaS), Server (self-hosted), Prep (Builder + Conductor), Public (free), Reader, Mobile, Bridge (private-data connectivity), Cloud Manager, Tableau Next / Data 360 (Salesforce-native), Exchange; roles — Creator/Explorer/Viewer

capabilities.label: Connectors
capabilities.detail: 100+ native (Excel/Salesforce/BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift/SAP HANA/Box/Drive), ODBC/JDBC, Connector SDK, published data sources, Virtual Connections, .hyper extracts, spatial, Custom SQL, live vs extract, Bridge

capabilities.label: Calculations
